description: Earthshatter Legguards Level 60 Rimblat Earthshatter at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Earthshatter Legguards if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Legguards, 20 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 3 Arcanite Bars and 5 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Legguards - Wartorn Chain Scrap x 20 - Arcanite Bar x 3 - Cured Rugged Hide x 5
